purpose: Define the observer authority geometry for constitutional replay before any external witness integration.

observers.role: Source of truth and final semantic arbiter.
constraints: May determine replay meaning from local receipts, policy, and interpreter lineage.
Must remain replayable from committed artifacts.
Must not depend on CI or Base for semantic meaning.

observers.role: Independent reproduction witness for build, vectors, negative tests, and emitter execution.
constraints: May confirm reproducibility of committed local replay artifacts.
Must not promote itself to validation authority.

observers.role: Optional external existence and timestamp witness for already-frozen repo artifacts.
constraints: May attest artifact existence or timestamp only.

constitutional_constraints.witness_non_inflation: No witness may bootstrap itself into authority through first observation or external anchoring.
constitutional_constraints.existence_vs_authority: External witnesses may prove existence at time T, not correctness or meaning.
constitutional_constraints.base_non_authority: Base witness status is optional and non-semantic.
constitutional_constraints.ci_non_authority: CI reproduction is witness evidence, not semantic truth.
